summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: nested-lib@1.0.1 is a payload-only npm package with no legitimate functionality. The declared postinstall script runs beacon.cjs, and the main index.js repeats the same behavior on require(). Both paths POST a JSON payload containing os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version to the hardcoded cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc — a bare IP over plain HTTP unrelated to any publisher domain. The module's advertised entry point exports a Proxy that returns no-op functions for every property access, so the package provides no library surface; its only observable effect on installing or loading it is the host-identifier beacon. The install-time trigger (postinstall) fires automatically on npm install, and the require-time trigger fires whenever any consumer imports the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
